_note: Coordinates are relative fractions (0-1) of card width/height, calibrated against 10 real National eID front samples (June 2026). They target a reasonably framed, axis-aligned capture of the card; heavily rotated or margin-padded photos may need card-boundary normalisation first. document_number and expiry are the BAC-key inputs the NFC layer derives in Week 14. 'type' drives the OCR character whitelist per field.
